name: Big Digital Energy, Inc. Common Stock
description: Big Digital Energy Inc, formerly Mawson Infrastructure Group Inc is focused on digital infrastructure platforms. It designs, builds and operates next-generation digital infrastructure platforms for enterprise customers and for its own purposes. The company provides services spanning AI, HPC, digital assets including Bitcoin mining, and other intensive compute applications. The company delivers both self-mining operations and colocation services to enterprise customers with a vertically integrated infrastructure model built for scalability and efficiency. The company also has an energy management business, which utilizes software and analysis, to generate revenue by participating in energy management programs. It operates as one energy management and digital asset mining segment.
